summary: 1969 two-story metal fire lookout on Dome Mountain above Pyramid Lake; closed 1980, reopened 2003 by volunteers, reached only on foot today.

facts.design: Two-story metal tower with the cab on top; cab given as 14 by 14 feet by the register and 365 square feet by the association; the 2011 blog gives 365 square feet for the whole structure

access.note: Reached only on foot; no source calls the tower closed or private, but none says visitors may enter the cab

visit.trail_note: About 10.8 miles with 2,620 ft of climbing from Frenchmans Flat Campground; the association's directions end with about 5 miles up an overgrown road

events.note: Built in association with the construction of Pyramid Reservoir
Delivered to the summit by helicopter, per the 2011 blog
Closed after about a decade of use; the blog gives no reason
Reopened by the Angeles association and rededicated (page gives 10/04/03); no repair work described
Registered September 3, 2014 as US 1045, CA 100; nominated by Mike Edwards
Staffed all year round, per the 2014 chapter report

corrections.why: Both sources describe a reopening and a 10/04/03 rededication; neither describes restoration work.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives a 14 by 14 foot cab (196 square feet); the association gives the cab as 365 square feet. The 2011 blog gives 365 square feet for the whole structure, not a cab figure, so it is not counted as a third cab size. The story reports both cab figures and does not choose.
All sources agree on 1969 for the build; the 1970 date is the helicopter delivery to the summit, per the blog.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 2003 'restored' is not supported; sources say reopened and rededicated. Cab size conflicts (14x14 ft in NHLR vs 365 sq ft in ANFFLA); the blog's 365 sq ft is the whole structure. Brief omitted the 1980 closure and 1970 helicopter delivery. Access 'public' is inferred from the hike-only trail and volunteer staffing; no official Forest Service access statement was found. Staffing as_of is the hiking guide's update month, not a staffing schedule. Photos not added.
